capabilities.description: Builds and certifies interim progress claims against the BOQ line items, applying retention and producing payment certificates per the contract.
requirements: Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.
Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.

capabilities.description: Tracks elapsed time against the 730-day Time for Completion and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10%.
requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date.
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.

capabilities.description: Captures and tracks Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) records for construction activities, with approval and audit traceability.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.

requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.

product_name: Harbourline Civil Works Contracts Administration Platform
summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that manages progress claims, delay-damages tracking, QA/ITP records, and a document register, treating the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record. It serves the project's contract administration team, quantity surveyors, and QA/QC staff who need clause-traceable commercial and quality control grounded in the contract excerpt (Clauses 8.2, 8.7, 11.1, 14.3, 4.2) and the priced BOQ.
